name: churnkey
description: Explore subscription retention, inspect cancel flows, and manage Churnkey configuration with your existing workspace permissions.

interface.shortDescription: Explore cancel flows and subscription retention.
interface.longDescription: Open Flow Explorer from the sidebar or a thread, review published flows and live performance, and mention a flow in the composer. Existing MCP tools support permission-scoped configuration management through Churnkey OAuth.
defaultPrompt: Review my cancel flow performance over the last 30 days.
